page.layout: One page of verse, one column, running down the full width. No margin notes. Page number at the head right. Signature mark at the foot right.

main_text.l: Pudet tuis me aufum effe dictis obloqui.
Pudet tua oblitum effe dextra, qua potens
Me texit usque cuncta per discrimina,
Ex quo tibi parens reliqui patrios
Chaldaeus arat, non me benignitas tua
Tellus colores, semper idem tu manes
Deus. Quid ergo filium moror tibi
Mactare, timens ne, si datur letho, ilicet
Hac esse vera credo, caerulei aetheris
Suum ergo filium iugulare vult senex,
Nec tanta fami[?] terret ipsum atrocitas

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s. The symbol before "usque" and "usquam" is a V-form abbreviation, read as usque. Line ending "fami[?]" is doubtful. The last line is cut off at the foot of the page.
